description_en: Creates and registers a Dataset Accelerator slot endpoint
description_zh: 创建并注册一个数据集加速槽端点
kebab_example: aliyun paielasticdatasetaccelerator create-endpoint --name endpoint-1 --type VPC --vpc-id vpc-j6co2fcdsl1q0gnuc0000 --vswitch-id vsw-j6cmr00qjyrft6jo20000 --instance-id inst-ivrq92qhbyrg4jctih --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateEndpoint

parameters.help_en: The name of the mount point. The name can be up to 64 characters in length. If this parameter is left empty (including an empty string), the system uses the value of the Uuid field as the default name
parameters.help_zh:
挂载点的名称。
长度限制为64个字符。
如果传入值为空（包含空字符串），系统会使用Uuid字段的值作为默认名称
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The network type of the mount point. The required parameters vary based on the network type. Valid values:
- VPC: The mount point is in a VPC network.
- INNER: The mount point is in the PAI internal network, which is used for access by other PAI services
parameters.help_zh:
挂载点的网络类型，根据网络类型不同，下列中需要传入的参数也有所不同。
- VPC：挂载点处于VPC网络。
- INNER：挂载点处于PAI内部网络中，用于PAI其他产品进行访问
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC used by the mount point
parameters.help_zh: 挂载点使用的专有网络 VPC ID
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the vSwitch used by the mount point. The vSwitch must belong to the specified VPC
parameters.help_zh:
挂载点使用的交换机vSwitch Id。
该vSwitch需要属于传入的VPC
parameters.name: vswitch_id
